name: wave5-quiet2-discovery-636-22-fourprofiles-v1.zip
acceptance_scope: Original per-entry source headers govern; ignored diagnostic control bytes have no publication-commit attribution.

coverage.server_profile_rows: 200 capped rows in each four-worker population;182exactquery_id+toplevel+SHA shared; top-level/nested kept separate.
coverage.serial_functions: First32measuredcycles perstage;96PBKDF2calls perpopulation; cProfile self-wall distinct from thread/process CPU.
coverage.source_query_mapping: Four exact public AST constants reproduce native SQL hashes; full query text/parameters were not captured.
coverage.source_custody: Original reported full fingerprints preserved;21publicGitblobs+20selectedactualphysicalfiles captured with raw hashes and normalized equality; no live full-tree scan.
coverage.raw_logs: All four short child logs and synthetic migration logs included byte-exact; no credential/DSN setup logs.

construction.json_index: flat record list; no filename-to-hash dictionary
